label: ريم — نجدية
ref_text: العنوان الحالي مسجل في حي النرجس، وتبي تغييره إلى حي الياسمين. الطلب ما زال في مرحلة التجهيز، فالتعديل ممكن بدون أي رسوم إضافية.
source: omnivoice-finetune/data/najdi_cs/wavs/najdi_cs_11_najdi_s7_08_clean_001.wav (id najdi_cs_00104; no najdi_cs clip is in najdi_v4, so the shipped checkpoints never trained on this voice)
notes: The female voice of the synthetic najdi_cs customer-support sets, where the agent calls herself Reem (sets 7-11), Noura (set 3) and Sara (set 13): one synthesiser voice under several names (speaker similarity 0.87 across its 74 recordings). She is not the trained voice Nora. No model here trained on her; the omnivoice_najdi models only clone her. From set 11. She has two segments longer than 9 s: this is the longest of the clips that are not measurably worse than any other (two standard errors over six sentences: four short, two long). Against the 6.0 s clip used until 2026-10-06 it is level on similarity (+0.005) and lower on UTMOS by 0.12, within noise; the 13.1 s segment is less like her.
